instruction: Disable the VLC cone logo that appears when no media is playing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully took a VLC snapshot of the Interstellar trailer frame, then navigated to Settings > Background to set it as desktop wallpaper. Completed in 25 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use VLC menus (Video > Take Snapshot), navigate Ubuntu Settings, set desktop wallpaper, interact with system tray
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VLC interface preferences. Agent proved it can navigate VLC menus; this variation requires accessing Tools > Preferences > Interface to toggle the background cone setting.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the VLC background cone via Tools > Preferences > Interface. Evaluator reads vlcrc config and checks qt-bgcone=0. Postconfig kills VLC to ensure config is written to disk.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config -> get_vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) from the VM, which is where qt-bgcone is stored.
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses vlcrc to find the qt-bgcone setting, defaults to '1' (enabled) if not found, and compares against expected value '0' (disabled).
Expected value '0' correctly represents the disabled state of the VLC cone logo, matching the instruction requirement.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly, which is correct since get_rule returns the rules dict.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring VLC writes its settings to disk on exit. The 2-second sleep allows time for the process to terminate and flush config.
Single instruction requirement (disable cone logo) is fully covered by a single evaluator check (qt-bgcone=0). Complete coverage.
